content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The ordering is where the selective revert meets the file it would rewind; this check forces it to answer to the revert, the file's place, and the persistence of the markers without re-deciding any. One prerequisite is code-layer (`ppwnzwwy`) and the rest prose, so this gate spans two cells, one of them the matrix's missing code→natural cell — the gate plus a flag to extend the matrix (and, if wanted, to split the gate).
